value.name: Asha withholds response
value.description: Asha stays silent and forces Devin to confront the discrepancy without helping him along.
evidence: Asha held her stillness and let him work.
She did not blink, did not let her eyes drift to the seam of the door or the strip of yellow light along the floor behind him, did not let her hand on the briefcase shift its grip.
Asha held the silence and did not help him into it.

value.name: Devin realizes he must answer
value.description: Devin understands that Asha will not spare him from naming the disputed timestamp and details.
evidence: His jaw set once more, and she watched him understand that she was not going to spare him the work of saying which timestamp, which margin, which minute of Monday afternoon he remembered differently from the version she had handed Whitfield a half hour ago.
she could see him weighing whether to put the minute down between them or whether to ask her first what she had given Whitfield

value.name: Devin hesitates over the discrepancy
value.description: Devin visibly weighs whether to state the minute or ask what Asha told Whitfield, showing his reluctance and uncertainty.
evidence: Devin's jaw set and eased and set again
she could see him weighing whether to put the minute down between them or whether to ask her first what she had given Whitfield

value.name: Devin steps into the kitchen
value.description: After a tense pause, Devin releases the doorway and moves into the kitchen light to speak.
evidence: after another short breath Devin let go of the door, stepped past the threshold into the kitchen light

value.name: Devin states the earlier timestamp
value.description: Devin finally says the time 'Four-eighteen,' revealing a version of events earlier than what Asha told Whitfield.
evidence: The number landed flat between them on the linoleum, earlier than the version she had given Whitfield by nearly forty minutes

value.name: Asha registers the discrepancy
value.description: Asha absorbs Devin's timestamp without changing her expression, signaling that she understands the significance of the contradiction.
evidence: and she registered it without moving her face.
He watched her register it, and she understood
